summary: Sarepta Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting a September 23, 2026 settlement agreement with REGENXBIO, the Trustees of the University of Pennsylvania, and Catalent resolving patent infringement litigations and an IPR appeal over U.S. Patent Nos. 11,680,274 and 10,526,617. Sarepta will pay REGENXBIO a $39.0 million lump sum within ten days, matching the litigation contingency recorded in Q2 2026. REGENXBIO and UPenn released Sarepta and Catalent from claims covering AAVrh74-capsid gene therapies, including ELEVIDYS, and agreed not to sue; the litigations are dismissed with prejudice. No admission of liability. This is a routine litigation settlement, not a special situation.
